title: REQ · Every scene asset has a palette-grid source and a generated PNG with a manifest entry
summary: ART_SOURCES covers room, boy, secret door and dust so art:generate writes all scene PNGs
description: Context: sources.ts ART_SOURCES holds only the hand cursor and BOY_SOURCES; ROOM_SOURCES (13 room/* grids) is not registered, and the secret door and dust mote have no grid. Desired: register all of them and regenerate. Expected: PNGs exist under public/assets and manifest.json has entries with real sizes. Why: content cannot reference PNG ids that do not exist.
acceptance_criteria: Given ART_SOURCES, when generateAssets runs, then entries exist for the 13 room/* ids, character:boy-sheet, character:boy-portrait, objects/secret-door-open, effect:dust and ui/cursor-hand
Given the generated secret door and dust grids, when sizes are read, then they are 32x64 and 4x4 and use only palette indices
Given the committed manifest, when its entries are compared to generateAssets output, then they are equal

out_of_scope: Redrawing existing room or boy grids

technical_constraints: Palette-indexed grids, deterministic generation, shared palette of at most 48 colours
Do not add ids to ROOM_ART_SIZES
definition_of_done: art:generate has been run and its outputs are in the tree
